privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters. Here's how ScanIQ handles your data.
privacy.localDataBody: All scan history and settings are stored locally on your device using IndexedDB. Nothing is sent to any server or cloud service.
privacy.cameraBody: The camera is used only for live scanning of QR codes and barcodes. Your camera feed is never recorded, stored, or transmitted anywhere.
privacy.noTrackingBody: ScanIQ does not use any analytics, tracking scripts, or third-party data collection. We don't know who you are or what you scan.
privacy.clearDataBody: You can clear your entire scan history at any time from the History screen. Uninstalling the app removes all data.
